name: Gillai
title: Levitical musician at the wall dedication
summary: Gillai was one of the Levitical musicians who took part in the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt wall under Nehemiah's leadership. He played musical instruments that David, the man of God, had appointed. He is mentioned only once in the Bible, in connection with the great celebration when the wall was completed.

keyEvents.title: Participation in the wall dedication
keyEvents.description: Gillai took part in the great procession at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall, where he played on David's musical instruments.

keyEvents.title: Part of the second processional choir
keyEvents.description: Gillai walked in one of the two large choirs that marched in procession atop the wall to thank God for the rebuilding.

keyEvents.title: Musical Celebration under Ezra's Leadership
keyEvents.description: Hegalai and the other musicians followed after Ezra, the scribe, who led one of the processional groups during the dedication celebration.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem Completed
keyEvents.description: The dedication of the wall marked the completion of Nehemiah's great project to rebuild Jerusalem's defenses after the exile.
